choice.basis: The dashboard uses a dual-axis chart where Hydroelectricity is plotted on the left y-axis and Nuclear energy on the right y-axis. The 2010 Hydroelectricity value is explicitly labeled as 35%. The 2010 Nuclear energy value is not labeled, and the y-axes lack numeric tick marks, preventing a reliable comparison of magnitudes across the different scales. Because the necessary condition of a decodable, comparable 2010 value for Nuclear energy is unresolved, no source can be established as having the higher generation share. Consequently, there is no supported route to a specific higher-share follow-up option.
